generation: Only report-gen delivery.capture/build and registered exporters produce report documents. The builder authors native inputs only. External renderers may inspect existing outputs.

matrix.scope_limit: Twelve complete reports, not twelve cases and not every possible input or style combination. Style/renderer regressions are separate tests.

families.scope: Native validation, translations, stable relationships, deliberate warnings and input hashes
Publication removes private notes, original images, metadata and redaction controls without mutating sources
Full native delivery PDF/DOCX/HTML/Markdown in three languages, output fidelity and producer invariance
All 578 authored table rows appear exactly once in every format, in PDF page order, with repeated PDF and DOCX headers
Stable LibreOffice renders actual DOCX; content, TOC, links, geometry and hashes are inspected
Guided delivery takes actual issues to fields and separates errors from recommendations
families.runner: new feature browser acceptance; must be recorded separately, not inferred from exports

families.scope: Recoverable form drafts survive reload and are isolated by project and target
families.runner: new draft feature acceptance; must include real failure/reload

families.scope: Optional visual review resumes annotations/page by exact PDF hash and invalidates stale content
families.runner: new persistent review acceptance; must include changed PDF bytes

families.scope: Installer checks dependencies, project directory and rollback with documented environment limits
families.runner: installer feature acceptance; no real install is claimed by this case

families.scope: Actual Microsoft Word compatibility only if Word is available
families.runner: existing Word acceptance kit with real environment receipt; otherwise remains not run

limits: All findings, evidence, severity values, coverage states and retests are invented.
Table-row counts and simulated acceptance contracts are not executed software tests.
Importer inputs are inert English parser fixtures and are not inserted into the localized report narrative.
Successful LibreOffice inspection does not establish Microsoft Word pagination.
Structural output checks do not establish manual review of every page.
The case does not claim all combinations, universal absence of bugs or complete elimination of dead code.
This file is a plan. Only retained runner receipts establish an executed result.
